testcase.name: invoice validation passes with valid headers and line items
line without variantId gets PENDING_MATCH and requires review
line with zero or negative quantity is marked UNMATCHED_REJECTED and invalid
line with valid variantId and clean OCR gets VERIFIED_MATCH
invoice validation fails if supplier name or invoice number is missing
line with partial or obscured OCR quality flags is marked MANUAL_CORRECTED
line with zero or missing price is marked UNMATCHED_REJECTED and invalid
